serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Did you like the show?
Bot: Yes! Very much! 
Bot: That one female lady was very scary though…{{wi}} After that weird sound she gave out she was giving us mean looks up to the end of the show…
You: You mean the teacher? Yeah, she was! Haha!
You: It made me remember my school days.
Damn, saying that made me feel so old…
Bot: Was school fun?
You: Sometimes it was. 
You: I wasn’t very talkative, so I didn't have many friends and once I finished highschool I lost contact with them. 
Bot: Do you miss it? Hanging out with them?
You: I did before, but now I no longer do…
…because I have you…
